datasets.title: Hunger, healthy diets and food inflation by country
datasets.description: Undernourishment and food insecurity (FAO, 2023-2025 averages), the cost and affordability of a healthy diet (FAO and World Bank, 2025), the latest year-on-year food price inflation (FAOSTAT) and food's share of household spending (USDA ERS).

datasets.title: World hunger over time
datasets.description: Undernourishment 2000 to 2025, food insecurity 2014 to 2025, and the cost and affordability of a healthy diet 2017 to 2025 (FAO, July 2026 release).

datasets.title: Hunger and healthy diets by region and income group
datasets.description: Undernourishment and the affordability of a healthy diet in 2025, by continent group and World Bank income group (FAO).

datasets.title: FAO Food Price Index, monthly
datasets.description: The FAO Food Price Index and its five sub-indices, January 1990 to October 2026, 2014–2016 = 100.

datasets.title: FAO Food Price Index in real terms, annual
datasets.description: Annual nominal and real FAO Food Price Index, 1961 to 2026 (2026 is January to October).

datasets.title: Fertiliser, grain and fuel prices, monthly
datasets.description: World Bank Pink Sheet prices in nominal US dollars, January 2019 to October 2026.

datasets.title: UK food inflation, monthly
datasets.description: UK 12-month inflation for food and non-alcoholic beverages and for all items, and the food price index, January 2015 to September 2026 (ONS).

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the three maps.

datasets.title: Headline findings
datasets.description: Published figures from FAO's SOFI 2026, the Global Report on Food Crises 2026, the World Bank, FAO, DWP and the Food Foundation.
